name: Why do quotes for the same small kitchen remodel vary so much, and how do I compare them?

mainEntity.name: Why do quotes for the same small kitchen remodel vary so much, and how do I compare them?

acceptedAnswer.text: A contractor quote is easier to compare when every proposal uses the same scope, plans, finish assumptions, and allowance structure. Look beyond the headline price for demolition, design, permits, inspections, utility upgrades, protection, cleanup, appliance installation, countertop work, and change-order terms. Elite Remodeling & Design can define a coordinated scope from design through construction, but you should still request clear inclusions and exclusions. Key factors include cabinet grade, countertop thickness and edge, hardware, backsplash area, lighting, flooring transitions, and warranty responsibilities. Give each bidder identical appliance information and drawings. Ask what could change the price after walls or floors are opened.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quotes vary because scopes may differ in design, permits, demolition, utilities, cabinet quality, finishes, allowances, cleanup, and hidden-condition assumptions. Compare identical plans and ask for written inclusions, exclusions, change-order terms, and likely cost variables.
